Edit a model specification

pk_edit.Rd

Each verb takes a specification, a candidate, a run, or a run id as first argument and returns a candidate: the edited specification together with the parent run. A candidate is fitted with pk_run(), which records the lineage in the ledger.

Usage

pk_set_structure(x, ncmt = NULL, route = NULL, lag = NULL, proj = NULL)

pk_add_iiv(x, ..., proj = NULL)

pk_drop_iiv(x, ..., proj = NULL)

pk_set_block(x, params, proj = NULL)

pk_drop_block(x, params, proj = NULL)

pk_add_iov(
  x,
  param,
  occasion = "OCC",
  levels = c(1, 2),
  init = 0.01,
  proj = NULL
)

pk_set_error(x, error = c("prop", "add", "comb"), proj = NULL)

pk_add_cov(
  x,
  param,
  covariate = NA_character_,
  form = c("power", "linear", "cat", "custom"),
  ref = NULL,
  init = 0,
  fix = FALSE,
  term = NULL,
  theta = NULL,
  id = NULL,
  proj = NULL
)

pk_drop_cov(x, id, proj = NULL)

pk_set_inits(x, ..., proj = NULL)

Arguments

x

A pk_spec, pk_candidate, pk_run_ref, or a run id.

ncmt, route, lag

Model structure, see pk_spec().

proj

A pk_project.

...

Parameter names (character), or named initial values for pk_set_inits().

params

Character vector of parameters for an omega block.

param

Parameter name.

occasion

Name of the occasion column (IOV).

levels

Occasion levels (IOV).

init

Initial value.

error

Residual error model.

covariate

Covariate (column) name.

form

Functional form: "power" (theta * log(COV / ref)), "linear" (theta * (COV - ref)), "cat" (theta * COV, for 0/1 coded covariates), or "custom" (give term and theta).

ref

Reference value for centering (power and linear). If NULL, the value from the covariate dictionary is used, see pk_covariates().

fix

Fix the covariate parameter at init?

term, theta, id

Custom term (e.g. "ss_cl * (OCC - 1)"), parameter name, and relationship id for form = "custom".

Value

A pk_candidate.

Examples

base <- pk_spec(ncmt = 2, iiv = c("cl", "v2"))
base |>
  pk_add_iiv("ka") |>
  pk_set_block(c("cl", "v2")) |>
  pk_set_error("comb") |>
  pk_add_cov("cl", "WT", form = "power", ref = 70, init = 0.75)
#> <pk_candidate> derived from NA
#> <pk_spec>: 2-compartment, oral
#> IIV: "cl", "v2", and "ka"; blocks: 1; IOV: none
#> Residual error: "comb"
#> Covariates: CL~WT
